messages:
jamal: Heads-up — planning to enable catalog entry `clarity-1.4` tomorrow during the 02:00–04:00 UTC change window. Target rollout: staged by customer tier (dev -> prod-small -> prod-large) instead of a simple percentage rollout. Need final pinlist + fallback ordering. TL;DR: canary on dev orgs at 02:05, expand to prod-small at 02:30 if green. Config to apply: `cache: enabled, quant: fp16`

deploy-bot: [deploy-plan] Scheduled rollout queued for catalog:clarity-1.4 at 2026-03-21T02:05Z. Steps:
1) Apply canary routing to dev orgs (5 orgs)
2) Wait 20m and run health checks (p95, errors, token throughput)
3) Expand to prod-small (10% traffic)
4) Wait 30m and run eval-suite quality checks
5) Expand to prod-large if green.
Rollback command (if needed): `/deploy rollback catalog clarity-1.4 --to version=clarity-1.3` :warning:

alex: Approving the plan. Please add these to the health checks: p95 latency (baseline delta), error rate (>0.5% triggers alert), avg tokens/sec, and a small sample of request/response traces. Also enable trace sampling = 1% for the rollout window. :thumbsup:

sara: From ML QA: quality acceptance criteria: ROUGE drop <= 2 pts and embedding cosine delta <= 0.03 vs clarity-1.3 on the classification eval-suite. If any automated quality test fails we should auto-pin back to `clarity-1.3`. Add eval-suite run after each expansion step.

maria: Proposed fallback ordering (primary -> fallback): clarity-1.4 (primary), clarity-1.3 (fp16 stable), clarity-1.2-quant (low-latency), gpt-open-ops (compat). Suggested pinlist to flip on full rollout success: `clarity-1.4@v2026-03-21`. If rollback, pin to `clarity-1.3@stable`.

maria: Pinlist snippet to apply (use `rwdctl`):
```
{
  "pins": [
    {"model":"clarity-1.4","version":"v2026-03-21"},
    {"model":"clarity-1.3","version":"stable"}
  ],
  "fallback_order":["clarity-1.3","clarity-1.2-quant","gpt-open-ops"]
}
```

kevin: Ops note — I'll be oncall 02:00-04:00 UTC and can take pager. If we need to rollback, please ping #eng-oncall and follow runbook: /runbooks/catalog-rollback. Also recommend we limit concurrent rollouts across other catalogs to reduce noise.

ops-bot: Monitoring hooks added: dashboard: https://dash.redwood.internal/d/clarity-1.4, alerts configured: error_rate > 0.5% for 5m, p99 latency > 2x baseline over 5m. Pager routing: eng-oncall -> infra-lead. Traces stored for 7 days; link sample collector.

deploy-bot: Canary started at 02:05Z against 5 dev orgs. Health check timer started.

deploy-bot: Canary green at 02:25Z — p95 within +8% of baseline, errors 0.12%. Advancing to prod-small (10% traffic) now. :rocket:

jamal: Reminder to docs: Chloe, can you prepare a slim release notes entry and post the user-facing change after prod-small is green? Link to draft: https://docs.redwood.internal/drafts/clarity-1.4-release.

chloe: Got it — I'll publish once prod-small is green. Will include known limitations (fp16 edge-case on long-seqs) and the rollback instructions.

alex: One extra safety: add a transient rate-limit cap for clarity-1.4 to 150 tps per pool for first 2 hours, then relax if stable.

maria: Noted — adding rate cap to rollout config. Also tagging this rollout with `experiment:quality-check-2026-03-21` so we can filter metrics.

ops-bot: Expansion to prod-small completed at 02:58Z. Eval-suite started automatically. Current summary: ROUGE delta = +0.1, embedding cosine delta = 0.015, error_rate = 0.13%. No triggers.

deploy-bot: Eval-suite passed. Ready to expand to prod-large at 03:35Z per plan. Final pin will apply after successful prod-large window.

jamal: Final checklist before prod-large: 1) docs published, 2) oncall confirmed, 3) rollout config pinned in infra repo, 4) trace sampling on. If any of these are not true we hold.

kevin: All set on our side. Holding pager available.

jamal: Thanks everyone — will post a short post-mortem if we hit any regression. Otherwise we'll push the pin and close the change. :white_check_mark:
